name: Aramis Group SAS
summary: Aramis Group SAS engages in the online sale of used vehicles in France, Belgium, the United Kingdom, Austria, Italy, and Spain. The company offers a range of automotive products and services, including financing, insurance, maintenance, contracts, warranty extensions, and automotive accessories. It operates under the Aramisauto, Cardoen, Clicars, CarSupermarket, Onlinecars, and Brumbrum brands. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Arcueil, France. Aramis Group SAS operates as a subsidiary of Stellantis Auto SAS.
